name: Kiskunfélegyháza (Hungary, 1990s–2008)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of white over light blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Kiskunfélegyháza: a crowned blue shield with a white church and a figure within a yellow baroque frame.
history: Flag of Kiskunfélegyháza used from the 1990s until it was replaced by the present flag in 2008.

features.role: Kiskunfélegyháza arms with crown and frame
